description: In a partially ordered set, an upper bound of a maximal chain belongs to that chain and is a maximal point of the poset.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.ChoicePrinciples.maximal_chain_upper_bound.{u} {α : Type u} [PartialOrder α] (C : Set α)
  (hC : IsMaxChain (fun x1 x2 => x1 ≤ x2) C) (x : α) (hx : x ∈ upperBounds C) : x ∈ C ∧ IsMax x
